record.question:
A company is an existing AWS Application Discovery Service customer completing an ongoing migration assessment. Its on-premises Linux and Windows servers have little documentation. The company needs an inventory, utilization history, running-process information, and network dependencies to build a total cost of ownership model before migrating workloads.

Which approach gathers the required inputs with the least custom development?

options.text: Define the applications in AWS Serverless Application Model templates. Use the templates to infer the existing servers' utilization and dependencies.
Import a spreadsheet of server names and allocated CPU and memory into AWS Migration Hub. Use this static inventory as the utilization and dependency history.
Install AWS Transform MGN replication agents and launch the servers on EC2. Collect production metrics after cutover to build the initial migration assessment.
Install AWS Application Discovery Agents on the servers. Collect utilization, process, and connection data, then export the results for dependency analysis and cost modeling.

explanation.text:
Option <<4>> collects the evidence the assessment needs before migration. Application Discovery Agents gather server configuration, performance history, running processes, and network connections. Exported observations can inform application grouping, instance sizing, and a cost model; collecting data is distinct from computing a complete business TCO.

Option <<1>> describes intended serverless resources rather than measuring existing servers. Option <<2>> supplies a useful inventory but cannot create utilization history or observed dependencies that were never collected. Option <<3>> begins server replication and delays the assessment until after migration, reversing the required sequence.

The existing-customer premise matters. AWS Application Discovery Service closed to new customers on November 7, 2025. AWS recommends AWS Transform for new discovery projects; existing customers can complete ongoing projects.

AWS references checked on 2026-09-18:
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/what-is-appdiscovery.html
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/application-discovery-service-availability-change.html

diagram_alt: Agents collect observed utilization and dependencies before those observations are used for costing and migration planning.

sources.supports: Agent-collected utilization, process and network data can be exported for cost models and dependencies.
New-customer closure occurred November 7, 2025, with existing-customer continuity and Transform guidance.

editorial_notes: Corrected inherited October 7 closure date to November 7, 2025 from the dedicated current availability page. Retained existing-customer eligibility and key 4.
